code:
import os, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); exec(open(os.path.join(OUT,"helpers.py")).read())
D=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"akr_panel.json"))); S=D["seq"]; PF=D["pf"]
mec=S["MEC14_Cel"]; ms,me=PF["MEC14_Cel"]
pos=[132,137,163,204,206,103,136,166,205,209,175,174,307]
orth=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"uniref50_members.json")))
res=[]
for acc,rec in orth.items():
    sq=rec.get("seq","")
    if acc=="Q20127" or len(sq)<150: continue
    a1,a2,_=nw_affine(mec[ms-1:me], sq); mp=pos_map(a1,a2)
    p_=pct_id(a1,a2); p_=float(p_[0]) if isinstance(p_,tuple) else float(p_)
    m2o={ms-1+i:j for i,j in mp.items()}
    row={"acc":acc,"organism":rec.get("org",""),"pid":round(p_,1)}
    for p in pos:
        j=m2o.get(p); row[f"{mec[p-1]}{p}"]=(sq[j-1] if j else "-")
    res.append(row)
od=pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("pid",ascending=False)
od.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"pocket_ortholog_conservation.csv"),index=False)
cols=[c for c in od.columns if c not in ("acc","organism","pid")]
cons={c: round(100*float(np.mean([r==c[0] for r in od[c]])),1) for c in cols}
print(f"{len(od)} nematode orthologs, {od.pid.min()}-{od.pid.max()}% identity over PF00248")
for c in cols: print(f"   {c:>6}: {cons[c]:5.1f}%  states={sorted(set(od[c]))}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(15,10.5))
# A register
lbl=["Y202","V203","Q204","I205","H206","D207"]; d=[10.83,8.86,0.93,9.76,5.76,11.37]
ax[0,0].bar(lbl,d,color=["#c0392b" if x<3 else "#bdc3c7" for x in d]); ax[0,0].axhline(3,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax[0,0].set_ylabel("distance to L-GalDH His124 tip (A)")
ax[0,0].set_title("A. Gln204 occupies the catalytic-His site\n(AF MEC-14 vs AF L-GalDH, 228 CA, RMSD 1.01 A)",fontsize=10)
# B tetrad geometry
pairs=["Asp-Lys","Lys-Tyr","Tyr-X4"]
mecv=[2.70,2.90,5.08]; akr=[2.66,3.11,3.70]; kv=[2.71,3.00,5.32]
X=np.arange(3); w=0.26
ax[0,1].bar(X-w,akr,w,label="AKR1B1 1US0 (His110)",color="#27ae60")
ax[0,1].bar(X,mecv,w,label="MEC-14 AF (Gln204)",color="#c0392b")
ax[0,1].bar(X+w,kv,w,label="Kvbeta2 1QRQ (Asn158)",color="#2980b9")
ax[0,1].set_xticks(X); ax[0,1].set_xticklabels(pairs); ax[0,1].set_ylabel("side-chain tip distance (A)")
ax[0,1].axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[0,1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0,1].set_title("B. Proton relay intact, fourth position broken\nMEC-14 matches Kvbeta2, not AKR1B1",fontsize=10)
# C pocket
pk=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"substrate_pocket_map.csv")); y=np.arange(len(pk))
ax[1,0].barh(y,pk.ca_dev,color=["#2980b9" if v<3 else "#d35400" for v in pk.ca_dev])
ax[1,0].set_yticks(y); ax[1,0].set_yticklabels([f"{a} > {b}" for a,b in zip(pk.akr1b1,pk.mec14_by_struct)],fontsize=8)
ax[1,0].axvline(3,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[1,0].invert_yaxis(); ax[1,0].set_xlabel("CA deviation (A)")
ax[1,0].set_title("C. AKR1B1 substrate pocket onto MEC-14\norange: no counterpart (C-terminal loop absent)",fontsize=10)
# D ortholog heatmap
M=np.array([[1 if od[c].iloc[i]==c[0] else 0 for c in cols] for i in range(len(od))])
ax[1,1].imshow(M,cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
ax[1,1].set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax[1,1].set_xticklabels(cols,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax[1,1].set_yticks(range(len(od))); ax[1,1].set_yticklabels(od.organism.str[:26],fontsize=6)
ax[1,1].set_title("D. 19 nematode orthologs: Gln204 fixed,\nno ortholog restores a catalytic His",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
